race.comment: WESTBOUND (2) settled last 21 days ago but closed steadily when beaten 3.2L. Pike now hops on board as he rises to the mile and he maps to sit much closer in the run. Laid the foundations fresh and can now explode second-up. LINCHPIN (10) scored impressively last start at 1400m, kicking away to score by 1.2L. Up in grade and distance here, but he drops in weight and the last start figure stacks right up. He's a big danger if he can run to that level again. WESTERN LADY (13) is another who got back on resumption and closed soundly, ending up 2.8L off Rock Fest over 1400m. She's another who will relish the rise to a mile and she looks in for a solid campaign. STREET BAND (12) has trialled nicely since his latest effort and out to the mile now looks a big tick. Can make an impression. MASMELO (11) can improve third-up and on the quick turnaround.
